title: FRMO: A Frictionless Flywheel
summary:
A flywheel embedded at a frictionless one comes to mind when we think of FRMO corporation. FRMO Corp, which stands for Financial Risk Management Organization,
is a low volume 325 million market cap investment holding company
that trades on the OTC pink sheet market. Stahl explained the intent behind FRMO at the 2012 annual shareholder meeting.

reader_summary.headline: Welcome to episode 122 of Special Situation Investing.
reader_summary.overview: Welcome to episode 122 of Special Situation Investing. The book Good to Great explores why some businesses achieve greatness. Within its pages, the author, Jim Collins, popularizes the concept of the flywheel effect. He draws a connection between turning a flywheel, a heavy disc-like structure that stores rotational energy and successful companies in the following way.

key_points.text: The flywheel image captures the overall feel of what it was like inside the companies as they went from good to great.
key_points.evidence_quote: The flywheel image captures the overall feel of what it was like inside the companies as they went from good to great.

key_points.text: No matter how dramatic the end result, the Good to Great transformations never happened in one fell swoop.
key_points.evidence_quote: No matter how dramatic the end result, the Good to Great transformations never happened in one fell swoop.

key_points.text: There was no single defining action, no grand program, no killer innovation, no solitary lucky break, no wrenching revolution.
key_points.evidence_quote: There was no single defining action, no grand program, no killer innovation, no solitary lucky break, no wrenching revolution.

key_points.text: Good to Great comes about by a cumulative process, step by step, action by action, decision by decision, turn by turn of the flywheel.
key_points.evidence_quote: Good to Great comes about by a cumulative process, step by step, action by action, decision by decision, turn by turn of the flywheel.
